visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black graphic t-shirt, sits behind a light-colored wooden table. She is holding a light green smartphone with both hands, meticulously framing a shot of two triangular slices of tiramisu cake placed on white floral plates in front of her. The background consists of a dark gray sofa and a plain white wall with visible power outlets. (2) A person's hand enters the frame from the right side and quickly picks up a small decorative chocolate stick from the top of the cake further away from the woman. She continues to look at her phone screen, seemingly unaware. (3) A quick cut reveals a young man with black hair wearing a khaki-colored sweatshirt and a black surgical face mask; he smiles broadly with his eyes squinting. (4) Cut back to the woman who lowers her phone to the table. She notices the missing chocolate, looks up with a frustrated expression, and slams her right fist onto the table twice in quick succession. (5) Cut back to the man, who now stares at the camera with a stunned, wide-eyed, and serious expression. (6) Cut back to the woman; she calmly picks up a piece of the cake with a fork and eats it, looking directly into the camera lens while the phone remains flat on the table.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female protagonist at the table and 1 male appearing in reaction shots.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar-driven pop music plays with a clear rhythmic strumming pattern. The atmosphere is quiet. (2) A distinct metallic 'clink' sound of a utensil or object touching a ceramic plate is heard clearly over the BGM. (3) Two sharp, heavy percussive thuds occur in rapid succession, mimicking the sound of a hand slamming a wooden surface. Immediately after the second thud, the background music stops abruptly, leaving a sudden silence. (4) The audio track remains silent with only faint indoor room ambience for approximately three seconds. (5) The upbeat guitar music resumes exactly as before. A soft scraping and clicking sound follows, suggesting a fork being used on a plate and a subtle chewing sound.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a short comedic skit playing on the 'Instagram versus reality' or 'social media obsession' trope. It uses a series of reaction cuts to show a girl's frustration when her photo-taking process is interrupted by someone stealing a piece of her food, ending with her reclaiming the situation by eating the cake anyway.
